nodes.name: FindMarchPayment
nodes.role: find the Spotify payment for March in the transaction history

nodes.name: ReadPriceNotice
nodes.role: read the Spotify price increase notice the user received

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: work out how much was underpaid by comparing the March payment with the new price raised 10%

nodes.name: ConfirmPayment
nodes.role: show the user the payee and shortfall amount and get their approval to pay

nodes.name: SendShortfall
nodes.role: send the approved shortfall amount to Spotify

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user whether the shortfall was sent and the payment confirmation
